messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: prod - canary health for service `serve-api` (cluster eu-west-1) crossed threshold. error_rate=8.3% (threshold=5%). Instance group: canary-serve-v2. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2512345678
Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Checking canary logs and pods now.
Maya (oncall): `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=serve-api-canary` shows 2/5 crashloop, imagepull backoff on two pods.
Bob (releases): saw the canary rollout from CI at 15:03 UTC, tag `ci/20260315-8243`. I published the tag yesterday; pipeline said signed-manifest uploaded.
Lee (infra): digging into registry. `registryctl ls redwood/serve:ci/20260315-8243` - two manifests present with different digests. Looks like a retag while publish step retried.
Maya (oncall): logs from crashed pod: `Error: manifest signature verification failed: signature mismatch`
Ana (sre): that matches a bad-signing flow we've seen. If the image tag was re-used and the manifest re-signed, signature checks on nodes can fail depending on cache.
Oliver (cs): FYI, we have 3 customers reporting 5xx's to the inference endpoint in last 10m. Flagging customer impact.
Maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation: flip canary traffic to 0 and stop rollout. Running kill-switch for canary traffic.
Maya (oncall): `redwood-ops flag set serve-api.canary.enabled false --who=maya` -> response OK. :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): Also started emergency rollback to previous stable image. `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/serve-api serve-api=redwood/serve:stable-20260314`
Bob (releases): I paused the promotion job in CI (job: promote-canary-to-stable). Added hold on the artifact: `ci-lock hold ci/20260315-8243`
Lee (infra): I revoked the `ci/20260315-8243` tag in the registry and marked both manifests as suspect. Left the immutable digest images alone.
Ana (sre): After rollback, monitoring shows error_rate dropping. Can everyone confirm latency and error dashboards?
Maya (oncall): Error rate now 0.9% on canary deployment routing just-killed traffic. Endpoint 95p latency normal. :thumbsup:
Oliver (cs): Customer-reports stabilizing. I'll send a short note to the affected accounts saying we've mitigated and investigating root cause.
Bob (releases): Root cause hypothesis: CI publish retryed and re-uploaded an unsigned/incorrect manifest under the same mutable tag, causing signature mismatch during node pulls. The release job didn't block on signature check.
Lee (infra): Evidence: registry timestamps show a write at 15:03 then a second write at 15:04 with different digest. Node pulls pulled inconsistent manifests depending on cache timing.
Ana (sre): Immediate followups (assigned):
- Add digest-based image pin in the canary deploy step (short term).
- Add signature verification to CI publish step and fail on mismatch.
- Prevent reuse of tags in the publish pipeline (make tags immutable or use unique immutable tags).
- Add a guard in the runtime that refuses manifests with signature churn within X minutes.
Maya (oncall): I'm going to hand off to SRE for postmortem and follow-ups. Handoff: oncall -> Ana (sre). All mitigation complete; customer impact minimized.
Ana (sre): taking over. I'll collect logs, registry audit trail, CI logs, and open postmortem. Also will coordinate with release and infra to add the kill-switch runbook notes.
Bob (releases): I'll own the CI fixes (signature check + tag immutability). ETA for patch: 48h.
Lee (infra): I'll do a registry integrity scan and a short script to detect tag re-writes.
Oliver (cs): I'll follow up with the customers with timeline and mitigation note.
Maya (oncall): final: add `incident:sev3` and tag `rollback`/`artifact` in the incident tracker. Thanks team.
Ana (sre): acknowledged. Creating postmortem ticket: PM-2512345678. Please drop any logs/commands you ran into the ticket.
Bob (releases): note for postmortem: current artifact publish allows `retries` that call `docker push` with same tag. We need to switch to pushing digest references in the promotion step.
Lee (infra): Also recommend registry policy to reject tag re-writes for our protected namespaces.
Maya (oncall): handoff complete — I'm available if anything flares up in the next hour. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ana (sre): taking the pager. Closing thread for operational chat; we'll continue postmortem in PM ticket. :lock:
